turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are you doing right now?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm well, thanks.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My dissertation is due in March and I've written literally nothing.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay, let's not panic yet. Would you rather start with the literature review, or jump straight into the methods chapter?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hang on, I'm going to chat with my friend for a bit. Just wait until I say I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, where did we put the remote?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Under the cushion, I think.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Your dog has stolen that poor kid's ball again.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Oh no. Rufus! Drop it!

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: He's not dropping it. He's doing laps.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: He thinks it's a game now. Have you got any treats on you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Some liver ones in my pocket. Here.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Rufus, look! Treat! Okay, good boy, give.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There we go. Should we apologise to the dad?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Yeah, and offer him a sticky, slightly chewed ball back. Lovely.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'll go. You put the lead on before he spots the frisbee.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, that's sorted. I'm back.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: No problem. So, where's your first chapter going to be?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Lit review. I need to remind myself what everyone else said.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Good. Just set a limit on reading, maybe two weeks, before you start writing.
